Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys. Solid Mongo associations are ORM relations, not SQL foreign-key constraints. ConversationMember is a parallel membership projection; participantIds remains a canonical contract. User IDs refer to User Service. No RagTrace entity exists in the current local AI schema; Langfuse holds monitoring snapshots. conversation: conversationId: Prisma Mongo association (declared Mongo ORM relation, not SQL FK); conversation: conversationId: Prisma Mongo association (declared Mongo ORM relation, not SQL FK); summary context: conversationId UNIQUE: logical one summary per conversation (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); source conversation: optional sourceConversationId (logical provenance) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); share context: conversationId: cross-service share context (scalar-ID
